title: Mac read for the sim-lease fix: hinge output, a reuse then status, crash reports
why: From the sim-lease-gaps lane via the coordinator, 00:56 CST Nov 15: #2787's paths that need a real Mac are not run: the text real `hinge get` prints, a reuse followed by `bin/sim-lease status`, and the SpringBoard and PosterBoard crash-report count. The command is the lane's; neither the coordinator nor triage ran it.
note: Ask: owner-run (or Mac session) read of real hinge output, a reuse then status, and crash reports. Item command {powershell: n/a, mac}: cd ~/claude-settings && for u in $(xcrun simctl list devices booted | grep -Eo '[0-9A-F]{8}-[0-9A-F-]{27}'); do echo "$u"; hinge -d "$u" get; done; bin/sim-lease status; ls ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports | grep -cE 'SpringBoard|PosterBoard' . Posted as owner item 876 (act-mac-sim-lease-read) at 05:39 CST Nov 15, on the coordinator's 05:37 ask for PR 3482; nothing waits on it.
